name: Screening for Depression and Follow-Up Plan
certification: Approximation of CMS eCQM CMS2 Preventive Care and Screening: Screening for Depression and Follow-Up Plan (MSSP APP Quality ID 134); related HEDIS DSF-E, not certified: follows the public specification with simplified code sets mapped to the codes Agere receives.
steward: CMS (CMS2 / MIPS Quality ID 134); related NCQA HEDIS DSF-E

citations.title: eCQI Resource Center: CMS2v15 Preventive Care and Screening: Screening for Depression and Follow-Up Plan (2026 performance period)
NCQA public measure page: Depression Screening and Follow-Up for Adolescents and Adults (DSF-E)
Medicare Shared Savings Program Quality Performance Standard: PY2026 40th Percentile MIPS Quality Performance Category Score (Dec 2025), Table 1 APP Plus Quality Measure Set
CY2027 PFS proposed rule summary for MSSP ACOs (Quality ID 134 proposed changes)

denominator.summary: Members 12+ at period start with at least one primary-care or telehealth visit in the period; enrolled.

exclusions.label: Active depression or bipolar diagnosis before the period (F32-F34, F31, F39)

numerator.summary: A standardized depression screen in the period (PHQ-9, PHQ-2 in an annual wellness HRA, or G8431/G8510); when positive, a documented follow-up plan (behavioral care plan, follow-up report or referral) on or within 2 days of the screen. Agere approximates the positive-screen branch: a screen counts when it is negative or a follow-up plan exists in the period.

criteria.label: Standardized depression screen in the period

notes: The follow-up-plan component for positive screens is reported separately in the gap evidence; HEDIS DSF-E uses 12+ and a 30-day follow-up window.
